title: 赫卡里姆·青铠远原
description: 幽灵半人马赫卡里姆四蹄稳立开阔石原，长戟垂直静持，厚重甲胄与青绿轮廓光保持非人威仪。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Hecarim is an armored spectral centaur with a dark metal humanoid upper torso, equine body, four strong hooves, a horned helmet, and flowing teal spirit accents. Preserve the integrated half-human half-horse anatomy without skeletal horror or exposed remains. Armor fully covers the upper body, and his long polearm rests vertically beside him with its butt grounded, not lowered for a charge.
art_direction.scene: Place him stationary on a broad open plateau with all four hooves grounded and visibly separated, head turned slightly toward distant stone pillars. The polearm remains motionless along one side. A hard teal rim and pale warm side light carve dark armor into bold wax-crayon planes, while sparse low clouds and enormous atmospheric distance create solemn scale without frightening mist.
art_direction.palette: dark iron, restrained teal, slate violet, pale amber
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
